provider.description: Alexandria provider id from discovery, e.g. 'sec-gov' or 'firecrawl-research-index'.

capability.description: Provider capability id from discovery, e.g. 'filings/company'.

options.description: Input object matching the tool contract returned by discovery (tool_detail 'full' includes it). Wrong option names come back as a per-result invalid_option error listing the valid ones.
